name: Trismus
description: A mouth-exercising devices that increases mouth opening and improves flexibility of the oral tissues
longdescription: Trismus, commonly known as lockjaw, presents a significant challenge in oral healthcare, severely limiting patients' ability to open their mouth and dramatically impacting quality of life. For individuals suffering from oral submucous fibrosis, the condition can lead to progressive mouth opening restriction, causing difficulties in eating, speaking, and maintaining oral hygiene. Traditional treatment methods often prove inadequate, offering limited long-term relief and requiring invasive interventions that can be both painful and expensive. The client brief challenged INDQ to develop a Therapeutic Devices that could provide sustained treatment for trismus patients, addressing the complex physiological limitations of oral submucous fibrosis. The prototype aimed to create an innovative solution that could offer extended therapeutic intervention, potentially slowing the progression of the condition and improving patient comfort. By focusing on a device that could provide consistent, controlled treatment, the team sought to transform the management of this challenging oral health condition, offering hope to patients struggling with progressive mouth opening restrictions.
